alt: Structures of the respiratory zone. Top: a terminal bronchiole opening into alveolar sacs, with the pulmonary capillary network (arterial red, venous blue) wrapped around them. Bottom: cutaway of a single alveolus labelled with alveolar pores (pores of Kohn), capillary, respiratory membrane, alveolar macrophage, type I alveolar cell (thin, covers most of the surface) and type II alveolar cell (cuboidal, secretes surfactant).
